sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Night Audit is the process of closing the day's business – the hotel's 'day end'. At night a designated auditor does this:

1. Verify settlements of all outlets 2. Post room charges + plan meals on in-house guests 3. Handle Departures/no-shows 4. Print Reports (Daily Report, FOCC) 5. Change software date (rollover).

Analysis Night Audit in HMS is a guided process — starts with Charges Posting (Shift+C) and is completed with Night Audit Process (Shift+N). If you make a mistake, you can rollback it from Reverse Night Audit.

subsections.title: 2.1 Charges Posting (Shift+C)
subsections.paragraph: The first step of night audit — today's room rent + plan meals (as per CP/MAP/AP) are automatically posted on all in-house rooms. Extra charges (restaurant, laundry) are already in the folio. Manual charges can also be posted from here.

subsections.title: 2.2 Night Audit Process (Shift+N) — Main Process
subsections.navPath: Night Audit ▶ Operation ▶ Night Audit Process
subsections.paragraph: The day-close master wizard — step-by-step checks run: pending KOTs, unsettled bills, no-show processing, room charge posting verification, date rollover. The next step happens only after each step passes.

subsections.title: 2.3 Reverse Night Audit
subsections.navPath: Night Audit ▶ Operation ▶ Reverse Night Audit
subsections.paragraph: Is the audit done by mistake (any charge miss/post mistake)? The first audit before reverse is rollback — the date is returned, with corrections, and then audited again. Restricted permission is available (manager/admin).
steps: Make the correction → run the Night Audit Process again

subsections.title: 2.4 Account Posting
subsections.paragraph: Posting the day's revenue heads to finance ledger accounts — room revenue, F&B revenue, tax heads. This is the bridge between FO/POS and the Finance module.

subsections.title: 4.1 Audit Logs
subsections.paragraph: Night Audit Log: When did the audit happen, who did it, what date is next. Charges Remove Log: Which charge was removed by whom — audit control. Both of these are evidence during dispute/audit.

subsections.title: 4.2 GSTR-1
subsections.paragraph: Invoice-wise outward supply data in GSTR-1 format — the accountant exports it in JSON/Excel and files it on the GST portal. B2B (company GSTIN) and B2C come in separate sections.
